lines.en: My shell scrapes along, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 挪一步，壳里的水就晃一下。
lines.en: Each shuffle sloshes the water inside my shell.

lines.zh: 腿从壳底下伸出来，又缩回去。
lines.en: Legs reach out from under the shell and withdraw.
Wet mud trails a shining line behind me.
I test each step, afraid of tipping over.
Seawater still seeps from inside my shell.

lines.zh: 这道湿坡我爬过不止一回。
lines.en: I have crawled up this wet slope more than once.
The grass rots where I press it.

lines.zh: 身体在壳里胀，走起来晃。
lines.en: My body swells inside; I rock as I walk.
I follow the smell of the tide.

lines.zh: 泥地上留下圆圆的印子。
lines.en: Round prints stay in the mud.
I listen to the ground as I go.
Dry land unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我背上的壳裂了一道缝。
lines.en: A crack has opened across my shell.
My shell presses the grass flat; every step sinks in.

lines.zh: 我挤过灌木，枝条都断了。
lines.en: Bushes snap as I push through.
I draw into my shell and wait for you.

lines.zh: 壳口朝下，谁也看不进来。
lines.en: Shell mouth down — no one sees in.
I listen for the sound of the sea.
This shell was not always mine.
I open a narrow slit.
It is all slime inside.
I do not need to breathe so often.
The sun heats my shell.
Something crawls on my shell.

lines.zh: 壳口朝海，我一动不动地等。
lines.en: My opening faces the sea; I wait without moving.
The seams on me still move.

lines.zh: 谁踩过这片泥，我都听得见。
lines.en: I hear everyone who crosses this mud.
This ground is not sea.
I press my shell into the soil.

lines.zh: 再一步，你就在壳口下面了。
lines.en: One more step and you are under my shell's rim.
I hear your bones.
An eye inside the shell watches you.
Flip me over? Dream on.

lines.zh: 活人的热气贴着泥面过来。
lines.en: A living warmth creeps along the mud toward me.

lines.zh: 你不该站在我的影子里。
lines.en: You should not stand in my shadow.
I claim this ground.
Iron in your hand does not frighten me.

lines.zh: 我抬一抬壳，你就往后缩。
lines.en: I lift my shell a little and you shrink back.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁锈味飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of rust on you drifts over.
The shell cracked. The inside shows.
I flinch inward, then open again.
Slime pools on the ground.
I rock and steady the shell.
...it hurts.
This much is nothing.

lines.zh: 我听见自己壳内的响动。
lines.en: I hear the stir inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地上一道痕。
lines.en: I retreat, leaving a smear.
It is growing back inside.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记在触须上了。
lines.en: I notch this blow into my tendrils.
That is not for me.

lines.zh: 海里的东西才合我胃口。
lines.en: Only the sea's own food suits me.

lines.zh: 你递得这么近，是想让我咬吗？
lines.en: So close — do you want to be bitten?
My shell parts a little.
Not enough to fill the mouth inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我闻到咸味，可这不是海。
lines.en: Salt, but not the sea.
One tendril extends.
Do not feed me by hand.
I swallow it, taste and all.
Bring more next time.
The shell is hard. Your foot must hurt.
Do not touch the crack on my back.
You struck me and the shell did not shift.

lines.zh: 我被顶得侧倾，又慢慢摆正。
lines.en: The shove tips me sideways; slowly I right myself.
The knock echoes inside my shell.

lines.zh: 你的力道还不如一条鱼。
lines.en: You hit softer than a fish.
I rock from the shove.

lines.zh: 壳太宽，这条路容不下我们俩。
lines.en: My shell is too wide for both of us on this path.
Slime is on your boot now.
We are not close. Do not press against me.
There is nothing like that in the shell.
The seaborn do not speak of this.

lines.zh: 我们在海水里才做那种事。
lines.en: We do such things in the water.

lines.zh: 壳口合紧，我不想谈这个。
lines.en: I clamp my opening shut; I will not speak of this.
Stop looking.
My shell would split.
This is no place to spawn.
I rock my shell mouth in refusal.
Your scent is wrong.
Ask again and I bite.
My shell lacks exactly this piece.
I curl a tendril around it.
Give it. Do not grab.

lines.zh: 我用触须把它卷进壳底。
lines.en: A tendril rolls it into the base of my shell.
This has the smell of the sea.
I drag it under me.
I lift it, slowly.
This bone is good.
I press it into the mud.

lines.zh: 这块骨头我压在身下存着。
lines.en: I keep this bone pinned beneath me.
You struck me.
Then I stop being polite.
My shell has opened.
I remember that blow.
Do not back away. I am faster.
I am shifting toward you.
The round shell rolls once.

lines.zh: 你站在我的呼吸范围里。
lines.en: You stand within my breath.

lines.zh: 壳口张开，我朝你的脚去。
lines.en: My opening parts; I go for your feet.
You started this.

lines.zh: 壳沿刮着地，我朝你滚近。
lines.en: My rim scrapes the ground as I roll toward you.
Something moves inside the shell.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的壳就压前一寸。
lines.en: Each step back, my shell gains an inch.
You are backing into the mud. Good.
A tendril is already out.
Listen — the shell rattles.

lines.zh: 你跑不远的，这里是陆地。
lines.en: You will not get far on land.
I aim my shell mouth at you.
Your shadow is on my shell.

lines.zh: 别动，触须已经对准你的脚。
lines.en: Hold still; my tendrils are aimed at your feet.
A tendril whips out, heavy.
I ram your shin.
My shell rim scrapes your skin.
That one came with brine.
I clamp onto your sleeve.
You are knocked back a step.
I shove from below.
The slime stings in a wound.
Three spines slide out.

lines.zh: 这一击是为了刚才那下。
lines.en: That was for the earlier blow.
The shell rises out of the water.

lines.zh: 退潮时我被留在湿沙上。
lines.en: The ebb tide left me stranded on wet sand.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，泥溅了一片。
lines.en: I land and splash mud wide.
No sea here, and yet I live.
The shell mouth opens first, the body after.

lines.zh: 空气里有血，很淡，是新的。
lines.en: There is blood in the air, faint and fresh.
I squeeze out of a gap.
Land can be eaten too.

lines.zh: 壳沿挂着海水，我甩了甩。
lines.en: Seawater hangs from my rim; I shake it off.
This land will change soon.
Heat makes my shell pop and crack.
The shell lands first and bounces.

lines.zh: 水其实让我舒服，可太深了。
lines.en: Water comforts me — but this is too deep.

lines.zh: 气浪把壳掀得翻了个面。
lines.en: The blast flips my shell over.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我的壳缝里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell's seam.
That force reaches inside the shell.
Hunger softens the shell.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，壳上全是焦痕。
lines.en: Lightning scorches the shell black.
Not even seawater here.
